name: collegiapp
description: Search, read and write your Collegiapp notes and add tasks from a chat, while the app runs on this computer.
long_description: Claude reaches Collegiapp's bridge on 127.0.0.1:4747. Ask it to save something to your notes, add to a note, file a note under a class or turn a plan into tasks, and it lands in the app without opening it. The first call asks you in Collegiapp to allow the connection; text Claude replaces goes to the app's trash.

tools.name: search_notes
tools.description: Search your notes by words, #tag or class

tools.name: read_note
tools.description: The whole text of one note

tools.name: append_to_note
tools.description: Add to the end of a note

tools.name: update_note
tools.description: Replace, retitle, file, tag, pin or archive a note

tools.name: add_tasks
tools.description: Add tasks in the quick-add grammar
